thread:
marco (cloud-int): Quick sync — before we submit to all three publisher portals we need to lock down SKU accessibility for the free trial tier and the cert flow (KMS & regional compliance). Who's taking ownership of each cloud's cert checklist?

devon (product): I can own the SKU packaging and trial gating rules. Will prep a single JSON manifest we can reuse across clouds. ETA EOD Tue.

rachel (partner-ops): I'll take AWS account linking, IAM role templates, and the sandbox restaging for publisher tests. Need the manifest ASAP.

jason (legal): I'll review the EULA + data residency bullets. Also need the public privacy/contact URLs and a copy of the trial terms we show in the listing. Send drafts.

alex (eng-integrations): I can cover GCP service account and Azure managed identity templates. Quick Q: do we require HSM-backed KMS for any region?

marco (cloud-int): Good split. For HSM: only EU & APAC regulated customers require HSM for our Private offering; for marketplace listing, we should flag KMS option and provide guidance, but not require HSM by default.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: AWS publisher portal requires seller account verified + 2FA before you can publish. GCP marketplace has a separate vendor onboarding checklist (billing + test deployment). Azure uses Partner Center validation.

devon (product): Draft manifest structure (WIP):
```json
{
  "sku_id": "redwood-core-std",
  "tiers": ["trial","standard","enterprise"],
  "trial_constraints": {"duration_days": 14, "concurrent_tokens_limit": 10000}
}
```
Use this to populate portal metadata fields.

rachel (partner-ops): @devon drop that JSON into the shared drive and tag me. I'll start filling AWS IAM policy and a minimal role trust doc. Also need marketing logos (SVG + 1x/2x PNG) and a short 280-char description for storefronts.

jason (legal): For EULA: include a subsection about inference data handling and optional opt-out for telemetry. Send me the short description and manifest by EOD Tue and I’ll return redlines within 24h.

alex (eng-integrations): Pasting a quick test deploy snippet for GCP sandbox — change PROJECT_ID & SA_EMAIL:
```bash
gcloud deployments create redwood-test --project=PROJECT_ID \
  --config=marketplace-test.yaml
# ensure SA has roles/compute.admin + roles/secretmanager.admin
```

marco (cloud-int): Proposed owners + deadlines: SKU manifest & store copy — devon by Tue EOD; AWS IAM & sandbox tests — rachel by Wed; GCP/Azure templates — alex by Wed; legal review — jason within 24h after manifest. I'll coordinate final submission Thurs AM.

devon (product): Ack. I’ll also include pricing metadata (per-token / flat-seat fallback) and a recommended meter tag set for each cloud.

rachel (partner-ops): Can someone confirm whether we want to enable auto-trial entitlement provisioning (1-click) or manual activation? Auto is preferable but requires entitlement hooks.

jason (legal): Auto-trial OK but need an explicit consent checkbox for data processing in EU. Add consent copy to manifest.

marco (cloud-int): Decision: enable auto-trial with consent checkbox in EU only. Rachel, that means hooking entitlement webhook to our onboarding lambda — can you coordinate with Alex?

rachel (partner-ops): Yep, looping Alex. @alex can we scope a small webhook endpoint and test payload?

alex (eng-integrations): On it — I'll mock the webhook and push a test payload to the sandbox by Wed afternoon.

marco (cloud-int): Awesome. Final ask: keep the publisher portal screenshots/manifest versions in the /partnerships/marketplace/drive folder and update the PR when ready. I’ll set a Thurs AM go/no-go. :thumbsup:

rachel (partner-ops): Adding checklist items in the drive now. Will ping as I complete each cloud. :rocket:

jason (legal): Will review once devon uploads copy.

devon (product): Uploading first pass now -> link: https://drive.redwood.internal/marketplace/173333-manifest-v1.json

marco (cloud-int): Thanks all — syncing again Thurs 09:30 if anything blocks earlier.

rachel (partner-ops): noted.

alex (eng-integrations): thumbs up

jason (legal): 👍
